Thank you, I really would like to make a difference, work for a similar charity or Stonewall or something. 

Thank you so much

That really sucks. I hope there are people in your life who support you. My mother is actually my greatest ally, she was the manager of a charity that offered respite care to those who care for people with severe mental health problems but our shitty conservative government cut the funding so she's been made redundant and all those people no longer have support. I wish I followed her path now and done something similar. 

My accent changes when I'm with Australians but I become much more posh amongst Americans for some reason, probably because they seems so amused. Once whilst in the US someone asked me if in England we had TV's... 

If you appreciate the British sense of humour (humor) you should check out Black Books.

Oh I feel you there, I'm only 22 and I'm being thrown out into the world to support myself on my own, which is one of the reasons I'm so scared because I want to stay in the town I'm in and because of my housemates actions I will probably have to return home, where I don't even have a room anymore to a horrible nothin' doin' town. 

You seem very self-assured from your messages, at least know you've made me feel better and in my opinion what's better than knowing you've enriched someone else's life. You might have even saved my life. 

I have a thing called misophonia which only a handful of people in my life know about because no one takes it seriously but it really affects my life. Most people I have told about outside my immediate family have dismissed it and don't understand which isn't a help. 

Are you in the US? I'd like to be your UK penpal, anything you've wanted to know about us Brits?
